title: Participle clauses
note: -ing / -ed clauses for reason, time, result · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: Walking down the street, I saw a friend.
items.cz: Když jsem šel po ulici, potkal jsem přítele.
items.gap: ____ down the street, I saw a friend.
accepts: Walking down the street, I saw a friend.

items.en: Shocked by the news, she sat down.
items.gap: ____ by the news, she sat down.
accepts: Shocked by the news, she sat down.

items.en: Having finished the report, he went home.
items.gap: ____ finished the report, he went home.
accepts: Having finished the report, he went home.

items.en: Not knowing the answer, I stayed quiet.
items.gap: ____ knowing the answer, I stayed quiet.
accepts: Not knowing the answer, I stayed quiet.

items.en: Seen from above, the city looks small.
items.gap: ____ from above, the city looks small.
accepts: Seen from above, the city looks small.

items.en: Feeling tired, we stopped for coffee.
items.cz: Cítíce se unaveni, zastavili jsme se na kávu.
accepts: Feeling tired, we stopped for coffee.

items.en: Having been warned, he was careful.
accepts: Having been warned, he was careful.

items.en: Opening the door, she noticed a letter.
items.cz: Otevřela dveře a všimla si dopisu.
items.gap: ____ the door, she noticed a letter.
accepts: Opening the door, she noticed a letter.

items.en: Built in 1900, the house needs repairs.
items.cz: Postavený v roce 1900, dům potřebuje opravy.
accepts: Built in 1900, the house needs repairs.

items.cz: Když si uvědomil chybu, omluvil se.
